aim_summary.goal: Add two horizontal copies of the existing front-panel button, one above and one below it, in an approximately equally spaced arrangement.
preserve_targets: front panel and all non-targeted model geometry
aim_summary.expected_outcome: The front panel contains upper and lower horizontal copies of the unchanged existing button, with approximately equal spacing around the original central button.

operations_plan.summary: Copy F008 to two front-panel locations above and below the existing feature.

steps.description: Create two untranslated-orientation copies of F008 at equally offset locations above and below its existing front-panel position.

expected_result.geometry: Exactly two new horizontal copies of F008 exist on the front panel, one above and one below the unchanged original, with approximately equal adjacent spacing.

validation_criteria.description: Exactly two new button features exist on the front panel.
The upper new button is a horizontal geometric copy of F008 and is positioned above it.
The lower new button is a horizontal geometric copy of F008 and is positioned below it.
The upper copy, F008, and the lower copy have approximately equal adjacent spacing.
F008 remains unchanged as the central reference and source geometry.
F001 and all non-targeted model geometry remain unchanged apart from localized placement of the two copies.
